Field CmbYear (dropdown, required) is on the screen.
Field TextBox1 (text, optional) is on the screen.
The form displays a month and year selection mechanism using comboboxes named CmbMonth and CmbYear.
Changing the month or year triggers the Show_Dates subroutine to update the calendar view.
The calendar grid is populated by setting the caption of CommandButton1 through CommandButton42 to the corresponding day numbers of the selected month.
The first day of the month is displayed on the command button corresponding to the day of the week it falls on in the first week.
Subsequent day numbers are set sequentially across the command buttons to fill the month up to the last day.
The form resets the colors and enables/disables command buttons based on whether they have a day number caption set or not.
Selecting a date (by clicking a command button) populates TextBox1 with the selected date formatted as D-MMM-YYYY and unloads the form.
Selecting a date calls Show_Selected_Date, which updates the month and year comboboxes to match the selected date and highlights the corresponding day button with a star image.
The form initializes by loading the current month and year in the comboboxes, calling Show_Dates, and attempting to load a date from TextBox1 if it is pre-filled.
